prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Lanterns Underroot illustrated hand-painted fantasy game UI art. Restrained antique brass/gold, weathered dark wood and root details, deep blue-teal recesses, moss green and warm cream highlights. Selective crisp readable edges and soft painted material shading, elegant low-ornament UI suited to small screens. No characters, text, letters, numbers, interface labels, mockup boards, screenshots, gridlines, watermarks or drop shadows. One SQUARE transparent2x2 atlas, exactly four equal square cells, generous15% clear margin around each complete small icon. Save/checkpoint status indicator: SAME small simplified brass-bound wooden lantern silhouette and base pivot in every cell. Reading order: upper-left dormant gray-gold unlit lantern; upper-right warmly lit lantern with exactly three tiny separate gold sparkle/dot accents close around top, meaning saving; lower-left lit lantern with a small crisp gold check-mark badge at lower-right, meaning saved; lower-right dim lantern with a small restrained amber warning triangle badge, meaning error. No alphabetic glyphs/numbers/text. Silhouettes simple and readable at32–64px; no fine filigree or broad lightcloud. Distinct static status icons, not a completed animation. No object or badge crosses a cell boundary, true transparent gaps.
